name: Service Box
author: Themepoints

sections.description:
The Service Box WordPress plugin allows you to easily create visually stunning content boxes with icons and engaging hover effects, making it perfect for showcasing services, features, or any content in an attractive and interactive way.

Live Demo | Upgrade to Pro | Documentation

Plugin Features

  • Easy & Lightweight.
  • Clean Design & Code.
  • Responsive & Mobile Friendly.
  • No Coding Skill Required.
  • 16 Different Service Style.
  • Service Style
    • Slider Style.
    • Grid Style.
  • Service Icon Picker Type
    • Font Awesome Icon.
    • Image Upload (Pro).
    • SVG Icon (Pro).
  • Space Between Services.
  • Margin Between Services.
  • Easy Service Option Page.
  • Set number of columns in different responsive devices.
  • Select how many service items you want to show.
  • Group Services by Categoreis.
  • Service Item Background Color Option.
  • Service Item Background Image Option.
  • Service Item Background Opacity Color Option.
  • Service Item Text Alignmet Option.
  • Service Item Padding Option.
  • Service Item Columns Option.
  • Service Item Columns Margin Option.
  • Unlimited Color Options.
  • Multi-Colour Service Box.
  • Service Title Show/Hide Option.
  • Service Title Font Color Option.
  • Service Title Font Size Option.
  • Service Content Font Color Option.
  • Service Content Font Size Option.
  • Service Icon Show/Hide Option.
  • Service Icon Color Option.
  • Service Icon Font Size Option.
  • Service Icon Line Height Option.
  • Service Button Show/Hide Option.
  • Service Button Font Color Option.
  • Service Button Font Hover Color Option.
  • Service Button Font Size Option.
  • Cross-browser Compatibility.
  • Unlimited Service box anywhere in the themes or template.
  • And much more!
sections.installation:
Using The WordPress Dashboard

  1. Install as regular WordPress plugin.
  2. Go your Pluings setting via WordPress Dashboard and activate it.
  3. After activate plugin you will see “Service Box” menu at left side on WordPress dashboard and find “Service Box Options”

Using FTP
1.Extract service-boxs.zip to your computer.
2.Upload the service-boxs directory to your wp-content/plugins directory.
3.After activate plugin you will see “Service Box” menu at left side on WordPress dashboard and find “Service Box Options”

How to use short-code?
When Service Box options setup done please copy & paste shortcode into your theme any where you want to display this service box.
